name: drawer
label: Drawer
description: A teleported slide-in panel from the left or right, with header, content and footer slots and optional parent scaling.

props.name: position
props.description: Which side the drawer slides in from.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is open on load.

props.name: parent
props.description: Optional CSS selector of an element to subtly scale/dim while the drawer is open.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: The stacking z-index for the overlay.

props.name: header
props.description: Header content. Can also be provided via the `header` named slot.

props.name: content
props.description: Main content. Can also be provided via the `content` named slot.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content, usually actions. Can also be provided via the `footer` named slot.

slots.name: slot
slots.description: Fallback trigger content when no `trigger` slot is given.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The element that opens the drawer (default slot).

studio.card: <x-components.drawer header="Drawer Title" content="The main content for your drawer goes here."><x-slot:trigger><x-components.button variant="outline" size="sm">Open drawer</x-components.button></x-slot:trigger></x-components.drawer>

defaults.content: The main content for your drawer goes here.

examples.title: Left & right
examples.description: Slide in from either side, with header, content and footer slots.
